meta.name: fullstack-guardian
meta.description: Builds security-focused full-stack web applications by implementing integrated frontend and backend components with layered security at every level. Covers the complete stack from database to UI, enforcing auth, input validation, output encoding, and parameterized queries across all layers. Use when implementing features across frontend and backend, building REST APIs with corresponding UI, connecting frontend components to backend endpoints, creating end-to-end data flows from database to UI, or implementing CRUD operations with UI forms. Distinct from frontend-only, backend-only, or API-only skills in that it simultaneously addresses all three perspectives—Frontend, Backend, and Security—within a single implementation workflow. Invoke for full-stack feature work, web app development, authenticated API routes with views, microservices, real-time features, monorepo architecture, or technology selection decisions.

copy.tagline: 构建安全的全栈网页应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要同时开发前端和后端并确保安全。
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to develop both frontend and backend with security in mind.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按“前端/后端/安全”三个视角一起实现全栈功能:写技术设计文档、做安全检查,再产出数据库到界面各层的代码,并落实认证、输入校验、参数化查询、输出编码与错误处理。
howto.when: 当你要求实现“跨前端和后端”的功能、构建带界面的 REST API、接通前后端数据链路等全栈任务时触发;也用于微服务、实时功能、技术选型等场景。

say.text: 帮我实现一个带登录和表单的增删改查功能,前后端一起做
say.note: Claude 会先写设计文档、做安全检查,再给出前后端代码。

say.text: 给这个用户接口加上认证和参数化查询,防止 SQL 注入
say.note: 它会按安全清单检查并更新后端代码。

say.text: 做一个从数据库到界面的端到端数据流,带错误处理

howto.what_en: Installed, Claude acts as a security-focused full-stack developer: writes a design doc, runs a security checklist, then codes backend endpoints and frontend components with auth, validation, parameterized queries, output encoding, error handling, and security logs; tests each component.
howto.when_en: Triggers for full-stack work: implementing features across frontend and backend, building a REST API with a UI, connecting frontend to backend, plus microservices, real-time features, and tech selection.

say_en.note: Writes a design doc and security notes before code.

say_en.text: Add auth and parameterized queries to this user API.

say_en.text: Build an end-to-end data flow from database to UI with error handling.
